portInfo.description: sainttropeztourisme.com (Office de Tourisme) presents a Provençal village on a peninsula — fishing harbour, events, and Côte d’Azur light. VPCC adds Place des Lices pétanque, Citadel and Annonciade Museum as heritage stops amid the fashion mythology.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Beaches only with last-tender margin (gap on operator hours)
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Photograph tender number before climbing into the lanes.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Saint-Tropez tender landing (Vieux Port / harbour area) — Quai / Vieux Port area, 83990 Saint-Tropez
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Tender ~1 NM then short walk into village. No cruise shuttle per VPCC.
